Verification framework

Documents are checked against the right source.

Requirements adapt to whether the applicant is an individual or company and to the work they want to perform.

EvidenceWhat is checkedOfficial source
CIPC company recordLegal name, registration number, status and directorsCIPC eServices ↗
SARS tax statusTax reference, TCS PIN and current compliance resultSARS TCS ↗
COIDA Letter of Good StandingCertificate number, trade name and validity periodDepartment of Employment & Labour ↗
CIDB registrationContractor status, grade, class of works and tender valueCIDB Register ↗
NHBRC registrationHome-builder registration by company name or numberNHBRC verification ↗
B-BBEE evidenceIssuer/accreditation, dates and affidavit commissioningSANAS ↗

Fair feedback

Ratings that come from actual work.

A customer can review only an awarded project marked complete. Scores cover workmanship, communication, timeliness, value and cleanliness; reviews can be moderated or reported.

01

Verified relationship

The reviewer must be the customer recorded on the completed project.

02

Useful detail

Five dimensions reveal more than one headline score.

03

Right of response

Contractors can add a professional public response.

04

Moderation

Disputed or abusive content enters a documented review queue.
